mapper.sql: id, analysis_id, status, error_code, regenerations, generated_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_interviews (analysis_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{analysisId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE q FROM interview_questions q JOIN analysis_interviews i ON i.id = q.interview_id WHERE i.status = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO interview_questions (interview_id, no, category, question, key_points, evidence, concept_ids) VALUES
(#{interviewId}, #{q.no}, #{q.category}, #{q.question}, #{q.keyPoints, javaType=java.util.List, typeHandler=com.vibenote.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, #{q.evidence, javaType=java.util.List, typeHandler=com.vibenote.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler}, #{q.conceptIds, javaType=java.util.List, typeHandler=com.vibenote.common.mybatis.JsonTypeHandler})
